title: Celebrating Ethereum at 10 in Awka
dek: On July 30, 2025, Greenpill Nigeria marked ten years of Ethereum with an afternoon meetup in Awka.
excerpt: Greenpill Nigeria's Ethereum at 10 meetup in Awka mixed a ReFi workshop, the global anniversary livestream and a showcase that included Water Cup.
body:
Greenpill Nigeria celebrated ten years of Ethereum on Wednesday, July 30, 2025, with an afternoon meetup at Naweschools in Awka, Anambra State. The chapter invited Web3 builders, Ethereum enthusiasts and local changemakers for an afternoon of learning, networking and community building.

The agenda on the Luma event page opened with a talk on Ethereum and its impact by a guest speaker from Ethereum Nigeria, followed by a regenerative finance workshop, "Turning DEGEN to Regen", led by a Greenpill Nigeria steward. Attendees watched the global Ethereum 10th anniversary livestream, shared pizza with an introduction to PizzaDAO, and saw a POAP and partner project showcase featuring NoiceApp, Water Cup, Greenpill dNFT and ETH Conference 2025. The day ended with a group photo, networking and games.

The meetup closed the chapter's Take the Greenpill education series, which ran from May to July 2025. In its recap on the Regen Coordination Hub, Greenpill Nigeria reported that its Ethereum at 10 meetups in Awka and Enugu drew more than 70 people.
